question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&0\\3&4&5\\2&1&6\end{bmatrix}$, calculate the cofactor $A_{13}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Form the minor
Deleting the first row and third column gives $$M_{13}=\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\2&1\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 2: Evaluate the minor
Thus, $$M_{13}=(3)(1)-(4)(2)=3-8=-5$$
Step 3: Determine the cofactor sign
Since $1+3=4$ is even, $$(-1)^{1+3}=1$$
Step 4: Calculate the cofactor
Therefore, $$A_{13}=(-1)^{1+3}M_{13}=-5$$
